title: Synthetic advisory board note: chair time
text: Synthetic advisory board note. An invented community oncologist said the subcutaneous option cut chair time from hours to minutes for several of her patients, and the infusion nurses preferred the shorter visits.

title: Synthetic field note: prior authorization
text: Synthetic field note. A fictional account manager heard that a regional plan added a prior authorization step for the oral agent, and one clinic said first fills were delayed by several business days while the form sat in review.

title: Synthetic advisory board note: rash mention
text: Synthetic advisory board note. A fictional nurse practitioner mentioned rash as a side effect she watches for after the first cycles, kept the discussion non-specific, and said she shares the product guide language rather than guessing rates.

title: Synthetic field note: mixed access and dosing
text: Synthetic field note. An invented field medical colleague said one clinic liked the oral daily dosing for convenience, while another stalled on coverage paperwork, so access and chair-time preferences both showed up in the same week.
